name: feedback
description: Voice-first feedback from a person to an AI agent on whatever the agent made. Document review: open a PDF as a local page, click a spot and talk (or type), comments pinned to page, line and paragraph (right-to-left scripts in reading order), transcribed through any OpenAI-compatible ASR endpoint (self-hosted Whisper/Parakeet or hosted), returned as structured, anchored feedback; per-comment outcomes and rounds. List forms: one answer per item (Remove / Keep for now / Ask me, Approve / Revise / Reject, rating, tick box, free text) with notes, suggestions and autosave. Text review (`feedback text`): select words in plain text or Markdown (scripts with read-aloud times) and talk. Email review (`feedback email`): Fine / Change per field, subject picks, a verdict per draft. Diagram review: every Graphviz box, connection and zone clickable. FRAMEWORK.md sets the rules: voice first, point then talk, pluggable transcription, close the loop. Skills document-review, text-review, email-review, feedback-panel, feedback-form-template, feedback-form-library. Formerly feedback-panel.
